messages:
mia: Quick triage — after PTQ build for ranky3b-v2 we see ndcg@10 +1.8% but MRR@10 -3.2% on the prod-like holdout, concentrated in short-query cohort. I attached eval split and sample list. Should we halt rollout?
raj: Can you paste the exact eval command/flags you used? seed etc.
mia: Sure: `./eval.py --model ranky3b-v2-ptq --holdout recent30k --cohort short_queries --metrics ndcg@10 mrr@10 --seed 42 --dedupe true`
lina: That pattern (ndcg up, mrr down) usually points at top-1 swaps — ndcg can gain from better ranking deeper while MRR hurts if top1 gets worse. Short queries amplify. Check topk diffs and tie-breaking.
ash (ash): FWIW saw a similar signature in 4-bit experiments — tokenization/truncation differences changed candidate lengths and occasionally bumped a lower-grade doc to #1.
yuki: Can we quickly diff top1 between baseline and PTQ for failing queries? `python -c "import json;..."` (i'll run it if you dump JSONs)
mia: Quick stats from the run: 1,230 queries with top1 change; 78% of those queries length <20 chars; in changed set ndcg increases but mrr decreases, top1 precision@1 falls ~4.1%. I uploaded `s3://redwood-eval/6087654321/sample_top1_changes.json`
raj: Does the eval harness use the same tokenizer/model-vocab across baseline vs PTQ? PTQ flows sometimes swap a tokenizer preproc step inadvertently.
lina: Also check candidate normalization/dedupe hashing. If dedupe uses raw text with whitespace/punct differences, candidate pool could differ. You included `--dedupe true` but which hash?
mia: Dedupe uses our standard `norm_hash_v2` (lowercase + strip html + collapse whitespace). The PTQ pipeline runner had a separate preprocessing container though — possible mismatch.
ash (ash): Another quick probe: run mrr@1 and ndcg@1 to see top1-only signals. If mrr@1 drops sharply but ndcg@10 improves, it's definitely top1 issue.
yuki: Also sample a handful where top1 swapped and run manual judgment on 10 queries — is the new top1 genuinely better or is it a snippet-length artifact?
mia: Pulling 50 samples now and running manual check, will post notes.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment paused (reason: evaluation anomaly detected)
raj: Good — block rollout until we confirm. Actionable checklist: 1) tokenizer parity check, 2) candidate normalization parity, 3) dedupe hash parity, 4) tie-breaker determinism (seed + sort stable), 5) rerun eval with `--seed 123,42,7` to check seed sensitivity.
lina: I'll own item 1 & 2. raj take 3 & 4. Mia keep evidence and do the manual sample labeling.
mia: Created ticket RERANK-4873 with sample JSON and the failing query ids. Linking it to the release. Re-running eval with tokenizer pinned to baseline and `--dedupe false` to isolate. Will post updated metrics (ndcg/mrr/mrr@1/ndcg@1) in ~2h.
raj: Also run a quick ablation: strip priming text/length-priming in input build — priming sometimes anchors the model differently after PTQ.
ash (ash): If we confirm it's a ranking signal flip (not a real quality regression) we can consider a localized rerank rule to preserve top1 for short queries while adaptive tuning for long ones. But don't do that before we understand root cause.
yuki: Thanks — ping me when artifacts are up.
mia: Will do. For now: rollout blocked, triage owners assigned, samples and eval commands in the ticket. :thumbsup:
